transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. I'm here because I've been making a lot of careless mistakes and having a really hard time staying focused on my tasks. I've also noticed it's been difficult for me to sit still and I find myself talking excessively, which is why I finally decided to seek help today.

Thank you for sharing that. To help me understand if these challenges are more consistent with a lifelong pattern or a more recent development, could you tell me if you experienced these difficulties with focus and restlessness during your childhood as well?

Yes, absolutely. I definitely remember struggling with these same issues during childhood, well before I was 12 years old. My teachers back in elementary school always used to comment on how I couldn't sit still and constantly made careless mistakes on my work.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports both significant inattentive symptoms (careless mistakes, difficulty focusing) and hyperactive/impulsive symptoms (difficulty sitting still, excessive talking) that have been present since childhood (onset before age 12). This clinical picture is most consistent with the Combined Presentation of ADHD. I have narrowed the candidates to this single presentation as the symptoms clearly span both domains.
